sampling.s1: one clip in each quartile of valid starts

loss.mse: uniform mean squared error over predicted DINO tokens
loss.l1: uniform mean absolute error over predicted DINO tokens

evaluation.state_readout_floor: about 11 PushT units and 9 degrees on held-out episodes
evaluation.state_readout_usable_when: block translation above about 15, or agent translation above about 15
evaluation.object_dynamics_metric: error of predicted DINO tokens versus the true future tokens inside a 3x3 window around block_xy * 224/512, compared with copying the current tokens
evaluation.rgb_centroid: pixel-only diagnostic; median 18px from the block state point, so it is not the state coordinate and cannot be applied to DINO tokens

model: existing frozen DINOv2 spatial dynamics, no architecture change in this step
